title: Emergency Kill Switch — Neutralize active auto-commit-push-shutdown.sh
description: Immediately stop and neutralize the active auto-commit-push-shutdown.sh script. Do not delete it yet; make it impossible to execute and prove that no process, cron, launchd, or other script can restart it. No git operations are allowed in this phase.
